Starting today is the "Summer Training 
Camp." Intensive training to improve 
skills is scheduled to begin, however—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look, look, Trainer-saaan! It's got 
an article about this year's Derbyyy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see here... 'The BNW Showdown...! A 
Whirlwind of Emotion, Shaking the 
Stands!'"

Winning Ticket was completely absorbed in 
the Twinkle Series magazine she had bought 
on the way.
choice_data_list: You've got to focus on the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah!! Right!! Sorry, sorry, I just 
got carried away...!!

—Our hot summer training camp with Winning 
Ticket has begun.
